text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
Ah... what a tragedy defeat is! —Yet, this 
too is the essence of a story. —Paying 
back my worthy rival will be the delight 
of the next performance.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And then I realize! The reason for my 
defeat... was a king's mercy. I focused 
too much on the other runners. —I must 
repent, and claim the throne of the 
generation's strongest next time.

text_block_list.name: Legendary Storyteller
text_block_list.text:
And so, taking the next step forward... 
they set their sights on the Japanese 
Derby, a stage worthy of proclaiming a 
King!
